title: Waveshed release manifest (latest.json)
description: Update manifest written by the AETHER release pipeline (python/release, release.yml) to R2 and relayed verbatim at https://waveshed.io/releases/latest.json; consumed by the Waveshed QGIS plugin and the downloads page. sha256 is fail-closed: a consumer MUST verify the digest and refuse to install on any mismatch/absence. Releases after 0.4.7 also carry a detached Ed25519 signature (latest.json.sig) over the exact bytes; see CONTRACT.md section 11.1.

version.description: Semantic version X.Y.Z of the release.

released_at.description: Release date YYYY-MM-DD (UTC), not a timestamp.

min_plugin_version.description: Minimum plugin version for these assets (advisory: the plugin warns).

revocation.description: Signed cumulative licence revocation list (License-v3.md); blob is base64 of revocation.bin.

sha256.description: Lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 digest; verified fail-closed by the consumer.
